corrections_applied.issue: Missing isolated run container initialization and management as required by Agents.md Bootstrap (lines 105-117).
corrections_applied.change: Implemented Bootstrap section: validated trigger envelope containing run_nonce and nextmessage. Added validateRunNonce() to ensure run_nonce is a path-safe identifier ([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+). Set up isolated run container at ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/runs/<run_nonce>/ containing state.json, messages.json, and store/store.json. Initialized these files when the run is new, and enforced that run_nonce matches across state.json -> current_state.run_nonce, messages.json -> run_nonce, and store/store.json -> run_nonce, refusing mismatched associations.

corrections_applied.issue: Semantic-operator calls and exchanges were not mirrored into the isolated store/store.json with the canonical run_nonce.
corrections_applied.change: Updated persistSemanticExchange to append every semantic-operator input/return exchange (including execution, json repairs, Step 3 loops, supervisory gates, and supervisory repairs) to both messages.json and store/store.json with the matching run_nonce and ISO 8601 timestamp.
corrections_applied.agents_md_basis: Agents.md Bootstrap, line 113: 'Every semantic-operator input/return exchange appended to that run's messages.json must also be persisted to that run's store/store.json with the same run_nonce.'

corrections_applied.issue: Step 3 internal loop inspection did not support nested schema structures matching Agents.md schema definition.
corrections_applied.change: Refined step3RequiresLoop and Step 3 transition logic to inspect Step_3.G.Loop_Decision.value or Step_3.G.Loop_Decision, Step_3.G.return_to.value or Step_3.G.return_to, and Step_3.step_3_completed.value or Step_3.step_3_completed, ensuring exact adherence to schema specifications.

corrections_applied.issue: Initial user utterance was not explicitly preserved verbatim as the initial user message for that run in messages.json and store/store.json.
corrections_applied.change: In new run initialization, preserved the verbatim trigger user message as the initial entry in messages.json and created an initial transaction in store/store.json under the same run_nonce.
corrections_applied.agents_md_basis: Agents.md Bootstrap, line 112: 'Preserve the complete user utterance verbatim as the initial user message for that run.'
